measure_description: Measured with Powercalc Measure on a setup of 17 Canvas panels plus the controller. The controller draws 4.7 W both when off and when on at minimum brightness (brightness 1 maps to 0% in the Nanoleaf integration).
measure_device: IKEA GRILLPLATS (Matter) for hs, IKEA INSPELNING (Zigbee) for color_temp
name: Canvas
